New Jersey: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open New Jersey on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 13, 2026. Same deadline for online, in-person, and mail registration. Mailed forms must be postmarked by this date.
  • In-person early voting: October 24, 2026 to November 1, 2026. You can vote at any early voting site in your county. Hours are generally 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. Monday to Saturday and 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Sunday.
  • Last day to apply for a mail-in ballot: October 27, 2026. This is the deadline for applications sent by mail. You can also apply in person at your county clerk's office until 3:00 p.m. on 2026-11-02.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open from 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.

Official election information: New Jersey Division of Elections – NJ Voter Information Portal

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Federal

United States Senator

This seat has a six-year term. Incumbent Democrat Cory Booker is running for re-election. New Jersey has no governor race in 2026 because the governor was elected in 2025.
